job.text: For Claire and the regional managers: has Elstead Park lost sales since the big garden store opened nearby in March 2026, in which categories, and is it only Elstead?

insight.important: Since the new store opened in March 2026, Elstead Park's garden furniture & BBQ sales have run about 40 % below the same months of 2025, while the other three centres' rose

title.text: Elstead Park's Furniture & BBQ Sales Have Run About 40 % Below 2025 Since the New Store Opened
